# Vercel: update edge config items in batch

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To update edge config items in batch, send a PATCH request to the edge config endpoint with SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for exact endpoint URL, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for required authentication headers, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for request body schema, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for successful response shape, and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for error codes. The batch update allows modifying multiple items in a single request SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for rate limits.

Search intents:
- Vercel edge config batch update
- Vercel edge config PATCH request

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/vercel-edge-config-batch-update --json
